Subject: Portal identity binding and PO routing — onboarding questions

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick responses so far. We're kicking off the vendor portal onboarding for MedBridge and ran into a couple of things where we need clarity before we map our systems over:

1) Identity binding: our procurement org uses delegated signers across business units. We need to understand whether Redwood's portal onboarding expects a single authoritative signer on the Order Form (org-level binding) or if you support signer-level binding (multiple delegated signers tied to sub-entities). If signer-level, what evidence do you require to prove delegation?

2) PO routing: our ERP sometimes emits POs with line-level GL overrides and different receiving locations per line item. Can Redwood route individual lines to different GL codes or would we need to pre-normalize on our side?

Attached is our MedBridge_Metadata_Spec_v1.xlsx (column/field examples). We're aiming to complete registration this week and want to avoid rework on field mapping.

Also: primary contact for procurement integration is procureops@medbridgehealth.com.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short session to walk through a sample PO.

Best,
Natalie Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Program Manager
MedBridge Health

Attachment: MedBridge_Metadata_Spec_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet, 24KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Portal identity binding and PO routing — onboarding questions

Hi Natalie — thanks for the spec, appreciated. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

On identity binding:
- We support two modes: org-level binding (single authoritative signer on the Order Form) and delegated signer-level binding (where we persist signer provenance per account).
- For delegated signers we require either (a) a signed delegation matrix on company letterhead or (b) DocuSign evidence tying the delegate to an organizational role. Either is acceptable; legal prefers a delegation artifact for audit.

On PO routing:
- The Redwood routing engine can route at the line level if you expose the per-line receiving location/GL in the PO payload. If that's not available we can support a pre-routing normalization layer (we provide a small mapping table in the connector).
- To give you a concrete recommendation we need 2–3 sample POs showing the variations (line GL overrides, multiple receiving locs).

Action items:
- Natalie: share 2 sanitized POs (or send access to a small sandbox feed).
- MedBridge: confirm preferred identity binding mode (org vs delegated) and whether you can provide a delegation matrix.
- Redwood: we'll circulate a mapping-template.csv to capture the fields we need for line-level routing.

I've attached the mapping-template.csv and looped in Legal (Kim) and Integrations (Mateo) to advise on the signature language and connector limits. Can we schedule a 30-minute tech+legal sync early next week? I have availability Mon/Tue morning PST.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mapping-template.csv (CSV template, 1KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Portal identity binding and PO routing — onboarding questions

Laura / team — quick legal note on the signer provenance topic:

1) If MedBridge will rely on delegated signers we should capture an explicit "Authoritative Signer and Delegation" clause in the Order Form. Proposed minimal language:
   - "Customer represents that individuals executing Order Forms on behalf of Customer are authorized signers and that Customer will make delegation records available upon request for audit."

2) If there will be multiple distinct legal entities under MedBridge using the same Redwood account, we need to ensure the Order Form references the specific legal entity (entity name + tax ID) to avoid PO acceptance ambiguity.

3) Evidence requirements: prefer a signed delegation matrix OR a confirmed DocuSign envelope that ties a delegate to a role. If MedBridge wants to avoid the matrix, we can accept a standardized delegation email chain but that increases review time.

I'll attach a short draft clause (orderform-signature-clause-draft.docx) for Laura to include in the Order Form packet we send to the customer. Also recommend we flag this as a legal gating item for activation (i.e., activation blocked until evidence received).

Kim Park
Head of Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: orderform-signature-clause-draft.docx (document, 4KB)
